landing.faq.title: Questions from parents
landing.faq.description: Everything you might want to know before storytime.
landing.faq.what.question: What exactly is Picturebook Star?
landing.faq.what.answer: It's an AI storytelling studio for families. You describe an idea in a sentence, and we turn it into an illustrated children's picture book — complete with a beginning, middle, end, and gentle watercolor art on every page.
landing.faq.ages.question: What ages is it for?
landing.faq.ages.answer: Stories are tuned for ages 2–10. You pick the reading level when you create a book — short rhyming tales for toddlers, longer adventures for early readers.
landing.faq.languages.question: Can I create bilingual storybooks?
landing.faq.languages.answer: Yes! Create the same story in English and Chinese, side by side. It's a gentle way to grow vocabulary in both languages at bedtime.
landing.faq.print.question: Can I print the books?
landing.faq.print.answer: Every book can be exported as a print-ready PDF. Print at home or through a photo-book service to make a keepsake your child can hold and flip through.
landing.faq.safe.question: Is the content safe for kids?
landing.faq.safe.answer: Absolutely. Stories are generated with strict child-safety guardrails — no scary imagery, no violence, no ads, and no tracking of your family's data.
landing.faq.cost.question: How much does it cost?
landing.faq.cost.answer: Every illustrated page costs 1 credit. New accounts start with 10 free credits — enough for a complete 10-page book, and no credit card is required. After that, top up with a credit pack ($4.99 for 15 pages, $29.99 for 100) or subscribe for 100 pages every month.

settings.storybooks.title: Storybook Studio
settings.storybooks.description: Turn one sentence into an illustrated picture book for your child.
settings.storybooks.field_idea_placehold: e.g. A shy little dragon who is afraid to fly, but learns to be brave with the help of a firefly…
settings.storybooks.style_heartwarming_d: Gentle and reassuring — a bedtime comfort read.
settings.storybooks.style_whimsical_desc: A surreal adventure into a world with its own rules.
settings.storybooks.style_humorous_desc: Funny and theatrical — and it talks to the reader.
settings.storybooks.style_wordless_desc: No words at all — the pictures tell the whole story.
settings.storybooks.style_educational_de: A real concept turned into a journey, with a fact on every page.
settings.storybooks.style_philosophical_: Poetic and spare — an idea to sit with, not a moral to learn.
settings.storybooks.field_art_style_hint: How every page is drawn. Chosen once — the illustrations cannot be redrawn after the book is made.
settings.storybooks.art_watercolor_desc: Translucent washes and paper grain — warm and classic.
settings.storybooks.art_collage_desc: Torn painted paper, layered and tactile — bold and playful.
settings.storybooks.art_pencil_desc: Visible strokes and cross-hatching — quiet and nostalgic.
settings.storybooks.art_woodcut_desc: Carved linework, high contrast — dramatic and theatrical.
settings.storybooks.art_inkwash_desc: Freehand brushwork and mist — serene, with room to breathe.
settings.storybooks.art_flat_desc: Clean shapes and solid colour — modern and graphic.
settings.storybooks.field_pages_hint: One illustration per page, so a longer book costs more.
settings.storybooks.wordless_hint: This style writes no text — the pictures carry the whole story, and every page is illustrated full-bleed.
